headline: Nighttime Fenrier
title: Nighttime Fenrier in Aniimo | Bonesky Level 24 at Night | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want the Dark and Ice Nighttime Fenrier? Start with a Nighttime Bonesky, which lives in Rosetower Woods at around level forty three to fifty. Raise it to level twenty four. Then the evolution must trigger at night, so check your clock first. Evolve in daytime and you get the normal ice Fenrier instead. Wild Nighttime Fenrier also roam Rosetower Woods. Did you evolve yours at night? Comment below!
description: Nighttime Bonesky evolves into Nighttime Fenrier at level 24, and it must be nighttime; the night forms are found in Rosetower Woods.
